annotations.text:
Direction locked: task-first home (Option A).

- Every row on Home is a CHANGE REQUEST you are part of — including "Recently decided," which lists closed change requests, never documents.
- Documents live on their own page with saved views: I contribute to / I own / everything I can see, plus person filters ("Owned by Jack").
- One coral element per screen; no owner/repo paths; no vanity stats.
Home: three buckets, all change requests — waiting on you, your submissions, recently decided. Clicking any row opens that change request's review page. Replaces the Inbox page.

Documents: saved views as chips (I contribute to / I own / everything I can see) plus removable person filters. Rows link to the document workspace. Search stays plain-language; the query syntax becomes an advanced affordance.
Document workspace: 4 tabs — Document, Changes, History (no count bubble), Access & approvals (renamed from Sharing since it also holds approver rules and required-approval count).

Change review lives INSIDE the Changes tab — document header and tabs stay visible, "← All changes" returns to the list.

- The conversation is a timeline spine on the page: comments are cards on the line, events sit on the paper — no growing box.
- Green checks mean approvals, and only approvals. Resolved threads stay comment cards, collapsed by default, with a faint gray check and a blended "Show N replies".
- Unresolved threads carry only a small dot + "Unresolved" — quiet until they matter.
- Resolution is logged INSIDE the thread ("Priya marked this as resolved"); a new comment reopens it. See the Thread states board for all four states.
- "Proposed version" is fixed chrome in the same place on every change request.
- Approve is green (success semantic); no assignee; decision floats bottom-right.
